journey.name: non-cjit channel opening shows no payment notification
journey.description:
Reproduces PR #787 issue #3 (🔴). Opening a regular (non-CJIT) Lightning channel must NOT be reported as a received payment: no "Payment Received" notification, and never several duplicates. When the app is in the foreground the only feedback is the in-app "Spending balance ready" toast.
Precondition: onboarded regtest wallet connected to the LSP, with a positive on-chain balance to fund the channel. No CJIT entry is involved here — this is a manual channel opening, not a CJIT receive. This build cannot buy a channel from Blocktank (synonymdev/bitkit-android#1669), so the channel is opened to the staging LSP node by hand (see ../README.md, Getting a Lightning channel).

actions.action: Start on the wallet home screen

Open Settings, then the "Advanced" tab (testTag "Tab-advanced"), then "Lightning Connections" (testTag "Channels"), tap "Get Started" or "Add Connection" (testTag "add_connection_button") and tap "Manual Setup" (testTag "FundManual")

Enter the staging LSP node id (testTag "NodeIdInput"), host (testTag "HostInput") and port (testTag "PortInput") from ./lsp GET /info, tap Continue (testTag "ExternalContinue"), enter an amount within the available maximum, then continue and confirm to open the channel
Return to the wallet home screen and keep the app in the foreground
Verify an in-app "Spending balance ready" toast appears (testTag "SpendingBalanceReadyToast")
Dump notifications: adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -A3 -i "to.bitkit"
Verify NO "Payment Received" notification was posted for this channel opening
Verify there are not multiple duplicate channel-ready notifications stacked in the shade
